name: apaleo
description: Hotel operations in the apaleo cloud property management system: properties, rooms and room types, rate plans and rates, availability and offers, bookings, reservations and guests, groups, folios, payments, invoices, maintenance, housekeeping and performance reports. Creates bookings, assigns rooms and checks guests in and out.
instructions:
## apaleo
This connector works with the **apaleo** cloud property management system (`https://api.apaleo.com`): properties, unit groups and units (rooms), rate plans and rates, availability and offers, bookings, reservations and guests, groups and blocks, folios, payments and invoices, maintenance and housekeeping, and performance reports. It can create bookings, change reservations, assign rooms, check guests in and out, set room conditions and create maintenance windows.

**Setup (5 minutes)**
1. In apaleo open **Apps > Connected apps > Add a custom app** (or on apaleo.dev register an OAuth *simple client*, client credentials). Give it the permissions the team needs, for example properties.read, unitgroups.read, units.read, rateplans.read, rates.read, services.read, companies.read, availability.read, offers.read, reservations.read, reservations.create, reservations.manage, reservations.assign-unit, groups.read, blocks.read, folios.read, payments.read, invoices.read, maintenances.read, maintenances.create, operations.change-room-state and reports.read. Leave out the write permissions for a read-only connector.
2. Copy the client id and the client secret (shown once) into `APALEO_CLIENT_ID` and `APALEO_CLIENT_SECRET`. The connector gets a token from `https://identity.apaleo.com/connect/token` with the client credentials grant and renews it every hour.
3. Run `apaleo_list_properties` to check the connection.

**Workflow**
- Set-up data: `apaleo_list_properties`, `apaleo_get_property`, `apaleo_list_unit_groups`, `apaleo_get_unit_group`, `apaleo_list_units`, `apaleo_get_unit`, `apaleo_list_rate_plans`, `apaleo_get_rate_plan`, `apaleo_list_rates`, `apaleo_list_services`, `apaleo_list_cancellation_policies`, `apaleo_list_companies`.
- Free rooms and prices: `apaleo_get_unit_group_availability` (rooms left per room type and night), `apaleo_get_unit_availability` (free rooms for a stay), `apaleo_get_offers` (bookable rate plans with prices for one stay).
- New booking: `apaleo_get_offers`, then `apaleo_create_booking` with the offer's ratePlanId and one timeSlice per night. Change it with `apaleo_update_booking`.
- Find a guest or stay: `apaleo_list_reservations` with `text_search` (name, email, reservation id), `apaleo_get_reservation`, `apaleo_list_bookings`, `apaleo_get_booking`, `apaleo_list_reservation_services`. Counts: `apaleo_count_reservations`. Guests are part of reservations (primaryGuest, additionalGuests) and bookings (booker); change them with `apaleo_update_reservation`.
- Front desk: today's arrivals are `apaleo_list_reservations` with `date_filter: Arrival`, `from` and `to` = today and `status: Confirmed`; assign a room with `apaleo_assign_unit` (automatic) or `apaleo_list_available_units_for_reservation` and `apaleo_assign_specific_unit`, remove it with `apaleo_unassign_units`; then `apaleo_check_in_reservation` (undo with `apaleo_revert_check_in`). Departures: `date_filter: Departure`, check the folio, then `apaleo_check_out_reservation`. Change dates or rate with `apaleo_amend_reservation`.
- Groups: `apaleo_list_groups`, `apaleo_get_group`, `apaleo_list_blocks`.
- Billing: `apaleo_list_folios` (with `reservation_ids`), `apaleo_get_folio`, `apaleo_list_folio_payments`, `apaleo_list_invoices`, `apaleo_get_invoice`.
- Housekeeping and maintenance: `apaleo_list_units` with `condition`, `apaleo_set_unit_conditions`, `apaleo_list_maintenances`, `apaleo_create_maintenance`.
- Reports: `apaleo_get_property_performance_report` (occupancy, ADR, RevPAR), `apaleo_get_revenues_report`, `apaleo_get_arrivals_report`.

**Switched off at install**: `apaleo_cancel_reservation` and `apaleo_set_reservation_no_show`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

**Reading the answers**
- Ids are readable codes: a property `MUC`, a unit group `MUC-DBL`, a unit `MUC-101`, a rate plan `MUC-FLEX-DBL`, a booking `ABCDEF`, its reservations `ABCDEF-1`, `ABCDEF-2`, a folio `ABCDEF-1-1`.
- Money is `{"amount": 120.0, "currency": "EUR"}` in major units. Reservation `balance` is negative when the guest still owes money.
- Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; times are ISO 8601 with the property's UTC offset. A night belongs to the business day it starts on; `to` is included for availability and performance, excluded for the revenues report.
- Reservation status: Confirmed, InHouse, CheckedOut, Canceled, NoShow. Unit condition: Clean, CleanToBeInspected, Dirty.

**Filters**: list filters that take several values are comma-separated without spaces (`status: Confirmed,InHouse`). `expand` adds embedded objects (`expand: booker,assignedUnits`).

**Paging**: lists take `page_number` (from 1) and `page_size` (up to 500) and return `count` with the total. A page past the end answers 204 No Content, which means there is nothing more.

**Changes with JSON Patch**: `apaleo_update_booking` and `apaleo_update_reservation` take a list of operations such as `[{"op": "replace", "path": "/comment", "value": "Late arrival"}]`.

**Errors**: 401 means the client id or secret is wrong or the token expired; 403 a missing permission on the custom app; 404 an unknown id; 422 a business rule (for example check-in before the arrival day, no unit assigned, a sold-out offer) with the reason in `messages`; 429 the rate limit.
prerequisites: An apaleo account with a custom app (OAuth client credentials) that has the needed permissions.

APALEO_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
APALEO_CLIENT_ID.help: apaleo, Apps > Connected apps > your custom app (client credentials): the client id.
APALEO_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: Paste only the client id, without spaces.

APALEO_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client secret
APALEO_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Shown once when you create the custom app; create a new secret if you no longer have it.

verifyHints.401: apaleo refused the client id or secret. Copy both again from the custom app in apaleo (Apps > Connected apps).
verifyHints.403: The custom app lacks a permission for this call. Add it to the app in apaleo, for example properties.read for the check.

tools.name: apaleo_list_properties
tools.description: List the properties (hotels) of the account with id, code, name, address, time zone, currency and status (Test or Live). Archived properties are left out unless include_archived is true.

status.description: Only these statuses, comma-separated: Test, Live.

country_code.description: Only properties in these countries, comma-separated ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (DE, AT, ...).

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

tools.name: apaleo_get_property
tools.description: One property with address, company and bank details, time zone, currency, payment terms, check-in and check-out times and description.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

languages.description: 'all' or comma-separated two-letter language codes for the translated texts.

tools.name: apaleo_list_unit_groups
tools.description: List unit groups (room types and other sellable unit kinds) with code, name, member count, max persons, rank and type.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

unit_group_types.description: Only these types, comma-separated: BedRoom, MeetingRoom, EventSpace, ParkingLot, Other.

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

tools.name: apaleo_get_unit_group
tools.description: One unit group with its description, max persons, member count and type.

unit_group_id.description: Unit group id (for example MUC-DBL), from apaleo_list_unit_groups.

tools.name: apaleo_list_units
tools.description: List units (rooms) with name, unit group, max persons, status (isOccupied, condition Clean, CleanToBeInspected or Dirty, maintenance) and attributes. Use it for housekeeping views.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

unit_group_ids.description: Only units of these unit groups, comma-separated ids.

unit_attribute_ids.description: Only units with these attributes, comma-separated ids.

is_occupied.description: true for occupied units only, false for vacant units only.

condition.description: Only units in this housekeeping condition.

text_search.description: Case-insensitive text contained in the unit name.

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

expand.description: Comma-separated embedded objects: property, unitGroup, connectedUnits.

tools.name: apaleo_get_unit
tools.description: One unit (room) with its unit group, status, condition, maintenance and attributes.

unit_id.description: Unit id (for example MUC-101), from apaleo_list_units.

expand.description: Comma-separated embedded objects: property, unitGroup, connectedUnits.

tools.name: apaleo_list_rate_plans
tools.description: List rate plans with code, name, unit group, channel codes, cancellation and no-show policy, minimum guarantee and whether they are derived from another plan.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

rate_plan_codes.description: Only these rate plan codes, comma-separated.

channel_codes.description: Only plans sold through these channels, comma-separated: Direct, BookingCom, Ibe, ChannelManager, Expedia, Homelike, Hrs, AltoVita, DesVu, Gimsi.

unit_group_ids.description: Only plans for these unit groups, comma-separated ids.

company_ids.description: Only plans of these companies, comma-separated ids.

promo_codes.description: Only plans with these promo codes, comma-separated.

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

expand.description: Comma-separated embedded objects: property, unitGroup, cancellationPolicy, services, bookingPeriods, surcharges, ageCategories.

tools.name: apaleo_get_rate_plan
tools.description: One rate plan with its pricing rule, restrictions, policies, included services and channels.

rate_plan_id.description: Rate plan id (for example MUC-NONREF-DBL), from apaleo_list_rate_plans.

tools.name: apaleo_list_rates
tools.description: Prices of one rate plan per time slice (night) in a period: the gross price, restrictions (min and max length of stay, closed, closed on arrival or departure) and the calculated derived prices.

from.description: Start of the period. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

to.description: End of the period. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

tools.name: apaleo_list_services
tools.description: List services (extras such as breakfast or parking, and services included in rate plans) with code, name, default gross price, pricing unit and whether they can be sold as extras.

text_search.description: Text contained in the service name.

only_sold_as_extras.description: true to list only services that can be booked as extras.

service_types.description: Only these types, comma-separated: Other, Accommodation, FoodAndBeverages.

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

tools.name: apaleo_list_cancellation_policies
tools.description: List cancellation policies with name, description, the period before arrival in which a fee applies and the fee.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

tools.name: apaleo_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (corporate accounts) with code, name, address, tax id and the rate plans and corporate codes they can book.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

text_search.description: Text contained in the company name.

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

tools.name: apaleo_get_unit_group_availability
tools.description: Availability per unit group and night for a property: units available to sell, house count, occupied units, blocked units and maintenance. Use it for a quick overview of free rooms by room type.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

unit_group_ids.description: Only these unit groups, comma-separated ids.

unit_group_types.description: Only these types, comma-separated: BedRoom, MeetingRoom, EventSpace, ParkingLot, Other.

adults.description: Number of adults to check availability for (default 1).

children_ages.description: Ages of the children, comma-separated (for example 4,9).

only_sellable.description: true to return only unit groups sold with the time slice template.

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

tools.name: apaleo_get_unit_availability
tools.description: Units (rooms) that are free during the whole period, optionally of one unit group or in one housekeeping condition.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

from.description: Start of the stay. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

to.description: End of the stay. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

unit_group_id.description: Only units of this unit group.

include_out_of_service.description: Count units that are OutOfService in the period as available.

page_number.description: Page to read, starting at 1 (default 1). An empty page answers 204 No Content.

tools.name: apaleo_list_available_units_for_reservation
tools.description: Units that can be assigned to a reservation for its stay (or for part of it), for choosing a room before apaleo_assign_specific_unit.

reservation_id.description: Reservation id (for example ABCDEF-1), from apaleo_list_reservations.

unit_group_id.description: Only units of this unit group.

to.description: End of the period to check, default the departure. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

tools.name: apaleo_get_offers
tools.description: Bookable offers for one stay: for each rate plan and unit group the total gross amount, the price per night (timeSlices), available units, cancellation and no-show policy and the minimum guarantee. Run it before apaleo_create_booking and copy ratePlanId and the timeSlices from the chosen offer.

property_id.description: Property id (a short code such as MUC), from apaleo_list_properties.

arrival.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD (or date and time).

departure.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD (or date and time).

children_ages.description: Ages of the children, comma-separated (for example 4,9).

channel_code.description: Channel to price for (default all channels the plan is sold on).

promo_code.description: Promo code of a special offer.

corporate_code.description: Corporate code of a company rate.

unit_group_ids.description: Only these unit groups, comma-separated ids.

unit_group_types.description: Only these types, comma-separated: BedRoom, MeetingRoom, EventSpace, ParkingLot, Other.

include_unavailable.description: Also return offers that break a restriction or are sold out.

tools.name: apaleo_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings (the booker plus one or more reservations). text_search finds a booker by last name, first name, email or company.

reservation_id.description: Only the booking that holds this reservation.

channel_code.description: Only bookings with reservations from these channels, comma-separated: Direct, BookingCom, Ibe, ChannelManager, Expedia, Homelike, Hrs, AltoVita, DesVu, Gimsi.

external_code.description: Only bookings with a reservation whose external code starts with this value (for example an OTA confirmation number).

date_filter.description: Which date from and to filter on: Arrival, Departure, Stay (overlapping the period), Creation, Modification, Cancellation, ArrivalAndCheckIn, DepartureAndCheckOut.

to.description: End of the date_filter interval. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

tools.name: apaleo_create_booking
tools.description: Create a booking with one or more reservations. Get an offer first with apaleo_get_offers and pass its ratePlanId and prices in each reservation's timeSlices. Returns the booking id and reservation ids.

reservations.description: Reservations to create, each {"arrival": "2026-11-20", "departure": "2026-11-22", "adults": 2, "childrenAges": [], "channelCode": "Direct", "primaryGuest": {"firstName": "Anna", "lastName": "Muster", "email": "..."}, "guaranteeType": "CreditCard", "timeSlices": [{"ratePlanId": "MUC-FLEX-DBL", "totalAmount": {"amount": 120.0, "currency": "EUR"}}], "services": [{"serviceId": "MUC-BRKF", "count": 2}], "comment": "..."}. arrival, departure, adults, channelCode and one timeSlice per night are required; channelCode ChannelManager also needs source.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key; a retry with the same key returns the first result instead of booking twice.

tools.name: apaleo_update_booking
tools.description: Change booking fields with JSON Patch operations: replace the booker (the whole object), or add, replace or remove the comment, booker comment or payment account. Example: [{"op": "replace", "path": "/comment", "value": "VIP guest"}].

operations.description: JSON Patch operations, each {"op": "add|replace|remove", "path": "/...", "value": ...}. Allowed paths: /booker (replace only), /comment, /bookerComment, /paymentAccount.

tools.name: apaleo_update_reservation
tools.description: Change reservation fields with JSON Patch operations: replace the primary guest (the whole object), add, replace or remove additional guests, comment, guest comment, travel purpose, market segment or commission, add a company, mark it pre-checked-in. Example: [{"op": "replace", "path": "/comment", "value": "Late arrival"}]. Stay dates and rate plan change with apaleo_amend_reservation.

operations.description: JSON Patch operations, each {"op": "add|replace|remove", "path": "/...", "value": ...}. Allowed paths: /primaryGuest (replace only, the whole guest object), /additionalGuests, /comment, /guestComment, /travelPurpose, /marketSegment, /commission, /company (add only, {"id": ...}), /isPreCheckedIn, /isOpenForCharges.

tools.name: apaleo_amend_reservation
tools.description: Change the stay of a reservation: arrival, departure, number of guests and the rate plan and price per night. Get valid prices from apaleo_get_offers first.

time_slices.description: One entry per night: {"ratePlanId": "MUC-FLEX-DBL", "totalGrossAmount": {"amount": 120.0, "currency": "EUR"}}. Without totalGrossAmount the current rate is used.

requote.description: Re-quote the price of nights whose rate plan does not change.

tools.name: apaleo_assign_unit
tools.description: Let apaleo pick and assign a free unit (room) of the reserved unit group to a reservation.

unit_conditions.description: Only pick units in these conditions, comma-separated: Clean, CleanToBeInspected, Dirty.

tools.name: apaleo_assign_specific_unit
tools.description: Assign a given unit (room) to a reservation, for the whole stay or part of it. Find free units with apaleo_list_available_units_for_reservation.

from.description: Start of the assignment, default the arrival. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

to.description: End of the assignment, default the departure. Date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

lock_unit.description: Lock the unit so automatic reassignment does not move the guest.

tools.name: apaleo_unassign_units
tools.description: Remove the assigned units (rooms) from a reservation, for example before assigning another room.

tools.name: apaleo_check_in_reservation
tools.description: Check in a Confirmed reservation that has a unit assigned: status becomes InHouse and the check-in time is set.

with_city_tax.description: Add city tax for this reservation (default true).

tools.name: apaleo_revert_check_in
tools.description: Undo the check-in of a reservation (status back to Confirmed), for a check-in done by mistake.

tools.name: apaleo_check_out_reservation
tools.description: Check out an InHouse reservation: status becomes CheckedOut and all open charges on the folio are posted. Only possible when the departure is not later than tomorrow; shorten the stay with apaleo_amend_reservation first otherwise. Check the folio balance before.

tools.name: apaleo_cancel_reservation
tools.description: Cancel a Confirmed reservation whose arrival is in the future: status becomes Canceled; the cancellation fee of the rate plan's policy applies. A canceled reservation cannot be reactivated.

tools.name: apaleo_set_reservation_no_show
tools.description: Mark a reservation whose guest did not arrive as NoShow. The no-show fee of the rate plan's policy is posted to the folio. It cannot be reverted.

tools.name: apaleo_create_maintenance
tools.description: Create a maintenance window for a unit: OutOfService (flagged but sellable), OutOfOrder (not sellable) or OutOfInventory (removed from the house count).

from.description: Start, date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

to.description: End, date and time with UTC offset (ISO 8601).

description.description: What is being repaired or why.

idempotency_key.description: Optional unique key so a retry does not create a second window.

tools.name: apaleo_set_unit_conditions
tools.description: Set the housekeeping condition of one or more units, for example after cleaning.

units_conditions.description: List of {"id": "MUC-101", "condition": "Clean"}; condition is Clean, CleanToBeInspected or Dirty.
